name: (04) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Blood's Curse) — 2 Intermediate — Treacherous Bonds

system.description: After successfully touching a regnant or thrall (possibly requiring a Physical Challenge), the thaumaturge corrupts an existing blood bond, turning the bound party actively distrustful and suspicious, even if unaware of the bond's existence. Targeting a regnant corrupts one thrall's bond; targeting a thrall corrupts only that bond. This power lasts one night. This path may only be learned by Kindred of 10th generation or weaker, and its powers only function against vampires of equal or better generation. It retests with the Occult Ability.
